skill.name: cron
skill.description: Manage cron scheduled jobs — list, create, and delete background schedules.

skill:
Valid target routes: `finance`, `obsidian`, `configuration`.
1. LIST (list, view, inspect, show): - Call `list_cron_jobs()` only. - Never chain creation or deletion tools after a list intent.
2. CREATE (create, add, schedule, set up): - Call `create_cron_job(jobName, schedule, targetRoute, payload)`. - If the user requests a daily note schedule, use: - jobName: `daily-note` - schedule: `0 6 * * *` - targetRoute: `obsidian` - payload: `Create my daily note`
3. DELETE (remove, delete, cancel): - Call `delete_cron_job(jobName)`.
- If a user specifies a delay (e.g., "in 5 minutes", "after 1 hour"), compute the exact future timestamp relative to the injected system time, then convert it into a valid, precise cron expression.
